title: Application parameters
description: Business values that change over time without a deployment. Each parameter has a data type and a list of values, each valid from its start date. The file gives the initial values; once a parameter is in the store, its values are changed with Set-ApplicationParameter.ps1.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 with seconds and an offset, such as 2025-01-01T00:00:00+01:00. Start dates must ascend.

value.description: Always a string; the data type tells how to read it. Decimals use '.' as separator.
